reviews.text:
We have recently changed vets and I am so happy we did!
My dog now doesn’t fear the vet so much due to the friendly staff that work here! She is able to settle in and look around in a light and bright setting that’s calm. There is a treat wall that the lovely Emily made a little treat bag for us to take home. Also a little tea for myself while waiting for paperwork.
Could not recommend creature comforts more!
My first vet for my first kittens . All the experience was very smooth from the booking to the consultation .

An amazing veterinary practice with professional friendly staff, super clean modern interiors and incredible service all round. We highly recommend it. Our little Pomeranian dog Finn is treated like a minor celebrity as all the other animals are!

I’ve been coming to Creature Comfort in Clapham Junction for the past two years, and I honestly wouldn’t dream of going anywhere else! This place is absolutely wonderful. The environment is lovely, and the staff are incredibly caring, kind, and helpful. They are always there to support me with any issues I have with my beloved pets, and their genuine care and compassion mean so much. It’s such a comfort knowing my pets are in such loving and caring hands. I’m so grateful to have found this amazing place and couldn’t recommend them highly enough! ❤️🐾
Highly recommend if you love your pet! We just got a new kitten and the team at CJ were so kind and welcoming. They obviously care about the animals and customers.

The team at Creature Comforts were so kind and caring during my dog's visit for a sore paw. They were endlessly patient, gave him (and me) lots of treats and I genuinely couldn't believe it when I left the clinic with a bill of around £2.52. Perfect service and lovely humans!

We love going to Creature Comforts Luna our Cavapoo is always so happy and excited to go . The team are so
Kind and welcoming to us . We had the pleasure of meeting with Alexandra at reception who so kindly offered to make me an oat latte which I thoroughly enjoyed with a biscuit and lovely treats for Luna 💓. Grace was also very friendly she looked after Luna during her visit and you can clearly see how much they team care for our dog so Thabk you so
Much ladies  Highly recommend 💓

We couldn’t recommend Creature Comforts more highly. Everyone is so calm, kind and caring, and they always make our Ragdoll cat feel as comfortable and at home as possible. We also really appreciate how affordable and accessible they make veterinary care.

Dear Marina! Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We really appreciate your support and are so pleased you had a positive experience with the Creature Comforts team. We look forward to welcoming you and your pet back again soon!

I’ve always had such a great experience at Creature Comforts Clapham Junction. Everyone is so lovely, knowledgeable, hands-on and gentle, and the whole experience is always great. I recently had an emergency and they handled everything so professionally and I was seen within an hour. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them!
